name: RootCue — Customer Follow-ups
author: rptechnologies

sections.description:
RootCue (by RootPro Technologies) remembers the next action for every customer — payment reminders, repeat visits, quotation follow-ups — and shows you who needs you today.

This plugin connects your WordPress site:

  • WooCommerce orders — pending payments become payment reminders; completed orders become revisit or review follow-ups, depending on your RootCue business template.
  • Contact forms — Contact Form 7, WPForms and Gravity Forms enquiries become new leads with a follow-up.

What it does not do:

  • It never messages your customers. RootCue prepares messages; you decide whether to send them.
  • It never changes your WordPress or WooCommerce database structure. Settings live in two options, removed on uninstall.
  • It never slows down checkout. Events are sent in the background with retries.

Every request is signed (HMAC-SHA256) with a secret only your site and RootCue know.

RootCue works in English, Tamil and Hindi, on Android, iPhone and the web. Reminders ring like an alarm, and for home-service businesses RootCue can save each customer’s location and give voice directions to their door.

External services

This plugin connects to RootCue, a customer follow-up service by RootPro Technologies, to create follow-up reminders from your site’s orders and enquiries. It does nothing until you paste your RootCue webhook URL and signing secret in Settings → RootCue.

What is sent, and when:

  • When a WooCommerce order is created or changes status (only if you turn on “WooCommerce orders”): the billing name, phone, email and company, the order number, status, total, currency and item names, and your site’s name.
  • When a contact form is submitted (only for the form plugins you turn on): the name, phone, email and message from the form, and your site’s name.
  • When you press “Test connection”: a test event with no customer data.

Data is sent to the webhook URL you paste (on the RootCue API, e.g. https://api.rootcue.rootpro.in), signed with your secret. Nothing is sent to any other service, and nothing is sent from your visitors’ browsers.

  • RootCue terms of service: https://rootcue.rootpro.in/terms
  • RootCue privacy policy: https://rootcue.rootpro.in/privacy
sections.installation:
1. In RootCue, open More → Integrations → Add → WordPress. Copy the webhook URL and signing secret.
  2. Install and activate this plugin, then open Settings → RootCue.
  3. Paste the URL and secret, choose what to send, save, and press Test connection.
sections.faq:
Do I need a RootCue account?

Yes. RootCue is free to start at https://rootcue.rootpro.in — create a workspace, then add the WordPress connection in More → Integrations.

Does it slow down my site or checkout?

No. Events are queued and sent in the background (with WooCommerce’s Action Scheduler when available, otherwise WP-Cron), with automatic retries.

What customer data is sent?

Name, phone, email and company from the billing details, the order number, total and item names. For forms: name, phone, email and the message.

My contact form uses different field names.

Use the rootcue_cf7_fields filter to tell the plugin which Contact Form 7 fields hold the name, phone, email and message.
